searchText: in EOFCREATE and RETURNCONTRACT, a container index is specified as uint8 immediate, but in the header num_container_sections is uint16. is this disparity intentional? i guess if uint8_max is addressable the number of sections is one more than what fits in uint8... but this reasoning doesn't apply to num_code_sections and JUMPF's immediate, they are both uint16
